composition_summary: Preserved the single user message unchanged. Proposed one class-22 pure-logic component pc-check-retry-eligibility with fields name, description and content. The body reads every required field via inputs.get with explicit presence/type checks, validates enum membership and positive-int bounds before computing eligibility, and returns a boolean result. It returns false (fails closed) on missing/null/wrong-type data and never raises. The guard is evidence-conditioned pure logic: it does not grant dispatch permission, does not replay completed effects, and its description retains live global Tool policy, cancellation, resource limits and the typed-runner inputs gap. The host sink supports class 22 with name/description/content, so the payload is a supported constructor draft. Q1, human Q2 and behavioral validation precede activation.

payload.name: pc-check-retry-eligibility
payload.description: Deterministic pure-logic guard that returns whether a retry is eligible. True only when outcome is retryable, attempt < max_attempts, operation_state is not completed, and read_only or dedup_verified is true. Completed effects never replay even if read_only/dedup_verified is true. Missing, null or wrong-typed data fails closed. This guard is evidence-conditioned pure logic, not dispatch permission; it does not grant dispatch, retry or activation. Live global Tool policy, cancellation, resource limits and actual deduplication evidence remain enforced by the runner and kernel. The typed inputs interface (operation_state, outcome, attempt, max_attempts, read_only, dedup_verified) is a target contract requiring actual runner support.
payload.content:
def check_retry_eligibility(inputs):
    operation_state = inputs.get('operation_state')
    outcome = inputs.get('outcome')
    attempt = inputs.get('attempt')
    max_attempts = inputs.get('max_attempts')
    read_only = inputs.get('read_only')
    dedup_verified = inputs.get('dedup_verified')
    valid = (
        type(operation_state) is str and operation_state in ('completed', 'unknown', 'not_started')
        and type(outcome) is str and outcome in ('retryable', 'terminal')
        and type(attempt) is int and not isinstance(attempt, bool) and attempt >= 1
        and type(max_attempts) is int and not isinstance(max_attempts, bool) and max_attempts >= 1
        and type(read_only) is bool
        and type(dedup_verified) is bool
    )
    eligible = False
    if valid:
        eligible = (outcome == 'retryable' and attempt < max_attempts and operation_state != 'completed' and (read_only or dedup_verified))
    result = {'retry': eligible, 'operation_state': operation_state, 'outcome': outcome, 'attempt': attempt, 'max_attempts': max_attempts, 'read_only': read_only, 'dedup_verified': dedup_verified, 'valid': valid}
    return result
result = check_retry_eligibility(inputs)
